subject: Private deployment demo — timezone coordination & security reviewers
content:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonapp.co>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@orbitalhealth.eu>, Helena Muller <h.muller@eu-client.com>, Kenji Saito <k.saito@apac-client.jp>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment demo — timezone coordination & security reviewers

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. We'd like a walkthrough of Redwood's private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) next week. Important constraint: our EU DPO (Helena Muller) and our APAC security lead (Kenji Saito) need to attend to validate data residency and key management.

High level ask: 45–60 min demo, plus 15 min for security Q&A. Our locations: HQ in New York (EST), legal & DPO in Berlin (CET), security in Tokyo (JST). Daylight savings is in effect in the US/EU next week, so if possible please propose slots that are safe for all three regions.

Can you propose 3 slots that work from Redwood's side (include UTC offsets) and indicate whether the demo can be recorded for internal review? Also, we have a mutual action plan we can share once the time is locked.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director of Infrastructure
HorizonApp

---
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonapp.co>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — timezone coordination & security reviewers

Hi Oliver — great to hear from you and happy to run this.

Quick answers: yes, we can record the demo (we'll mask customer data in any example traces) and we can include a short security-focused runbook after the demo. I've attached a draft mutual-action-plan and a small availability grid converted to UTC/CET/JST.

Proposed slots (all times shown as local equivalents):
- Option A: 2026-04-05 14:00 UTC / 10:00 EDT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST (60 min + 15 Q&A)
- Option B: 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC / 05:00 EDT / 10:00 CET / 18:00 JST (45 min + 15 Q&A)
- Option C: 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC / 12:00 EDT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST (60 min + 15 Q&A)

Notes:
- Option B is early for the US but often works for EU/APAC overlap.
- Option C pushes late for JST; we can swap presenters to reduce presenter fatigue.

Can Helena and Kenji flag which of these are feasible? If none work, send 2–3 windows from your side and we'll adapt.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: HorizonApp_mutual-action-plan.xlsx; avail-grid-UTC-CET-JST.csv; meeting-invite-private-deploy.ics

---
From: Helena Muller <h.muller@eu-client.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonapp.co>
Cc: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@orbitalhealth.eu>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 17:35:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — timezone coordination & security reviewers

Hi all,

Thanks for proposing times. From the DPO side: the meeting should include a short run-through of key management (KMS/HSM options), data retention controls, and audit log exports. I can make Option A (15:00 CET) or Option B (10:00 CET). Option C (17:00 CET) is okay but later in the day for us—acceptable if necessary.

A couple of requests before the call:
- Please confirm whether any sample data in the demo is synthetic or real (we prefer synthetic).
- Share a short tech diagram of the private control plane and where customer keys are held.

Best,
Helena Muller
EU DPO (external advisor)

---
From: hiro_tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonapp.co>
Cc: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kenji Saito <k.saito@apac-client.jp>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 02:10:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — timezone coordination & security reviewers

Hi team — jumping in from APAC. Quick clarifications:
- Japan does not observe daylight savings, so our local offsets are stable (JST = UTC+9).
- For Kenji (APAC security), late evenings JST are okay but we'd prefer the demo not run after 01:30 JST.

Mapping your slots to JST (per Karthik's grid):
- Option A -> 23:00 JST (OK, short night but doable for Kenji)
- Option B -> 18:00 JST (ideal overlap for APAC + EU)
- Option C -> 01:00 JST (borderline; Kenji can attend but prefers earlier)

I can host the APAC-side security Q&A and will bring a short slide on our recommended KMS integrations. We can also run a very brief pre-demo security checklist (10 min) if Helena wants to escalate anything ahead of time.

Hiro Tanaka
APAC Security Solutions | Redwood Inference

---
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonapp.co>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, hiro_tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Helena Muller <h.muller@eu-client.com>, Kenji Saito <k.saito@apac-client.jp>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 18:50:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — timezone coordination & security reviewers

Thanks, everyone — Option B (2026-04-06 09:00 UTC / 05:00 EDT / 10:00 CET / 18:00 JST) works best for our group.

Karthik — please lock that slot and send a calendar invite. Two quick asks:
1) We need a short pre-read with the tech diagram Helena asked for (PDF).
2) Please include a recording consent note in the invite so our legal team is comfortable.

I'll circulate an internal calendar hold for the DPO and APAC security lead as soon as I get the invite.

Appreciate the flexibility — see you on the 6th.

Oliver
Director of Infrastructure | HorizonApp
